context: living spec: events (capabilities/events/spec.md), read manually to ground the spec — the living-specs registry isn't configured in this repo

constraint: spec 013 deliberately split AGM recording out of the generic Event entity into AnnualGeneralMeeting — this change must not re-merge the data model, only the All Events screen's read/search layer
intent: Show AGMs as rows on the All Events screen, alongside ordinary events, without changing how AGMs are stored or how their own dedicated screens work
expectations: Merging the Event and AnnualGeneralMeeting data models into one table/entity
Changing the Dashboard Events tile, Committee report, or other screens that read Event/AGM data outside the All Events list
Changing how AGMs are scheduled, recorded, archived, or how their attendance/committee elections work
Letting the All Events screen's 'Schedule Event' action create an AGM
approach: Add a new read-only ICombinedEventListService (Events module) that merges IEventService.GetAllAsync() and IAgmService.GetPastAsync() into CombinedEventListItem rows, sorted by date descending; EventList.razor/.razor.cs render the merged list in the existing RadzenDataGrid with per-kind Status/Actions branches, routing AGM rows to /events/agm/{id} instead of the generic event detail screen.

decisions.decision: Merge logic lives in a new Core service (ICombinedEventListService), not inline in EventList.razor.cs
decisions.why: matches the existing IEventAttendanceSheetService read-model pattern, keeps FR-006 route mapping unit-testable, and respects the no-cross-module-concrete-dependency rule (depends on IEventService/IAgmService only)
decisions.rejected: zipping the two service results directly inside the component

decisions.decision: Reuse IAgmService.GetPastAsync() and IEventService.GetAllAsync() unchanged; no new repository methods
decisions.why: GetPastOrderedAsync has no date predicate and already returns future-scheduled AGMs; both sources already carry EF Core !IsDeleted query filters, satisfying FR-010 for free

decisions.decision: CombinedEventListItem carries raw values (Date, TypeName, ParticipationRate, IsAgmRecorded, DetailUrl) not pre-formatted display strings
decisions.why: keeps date/percent/badge formatting in Razor where EventList/AgmList already have it correct, minimizing the diff

decisions.decision: DetailUrl is precomputed per-kind in the Core service, not branched in Razor
decisions.why: FR-006 is safety-critical (AGM rows must never open the generic event detail screen); a Core unit test can assert the literal route string directly
decisions.rejected: building the href inline in the Razor template via a Kind conditional

decisions.decision: Event row TypeName falls back to the em-dash literal (e.g. e.EventType?.Name ?? "—") rather than the task text's literal EventType.Name
decisions.why: EventRepository.GetAllAsync() does not Include(e => e.EventType), so EventType is null after a plain GetAllAsync() call today; EventList.razor's current template already defensively renders e.EventType?.Name ?? "—" for exactly this reason -- the fallback preserves existing production behavior (FR-011: no behavior change) rather than assuming an Include that was never actually there
decisions.rejected: Adding .Include(e => e.EventType) to EventRepository.GetAllAsync() to make EventType.Name always non-null -- out of scope: not requested by spec 023, and changes shared repository behavior other callers depend on

plan.key_finding: IAgmService.GetPastAsync() already returns all non-archived AGMs including future-scheduled ones (no date filter despite the name), and both Event/AGM query filters already exclude soft-deleted rows -- so FR-010 needs zero new filtering code.
